Her irises head and torso converge toward the same target, the adult man at the threshold. She holds the threshold open with one shoulder while extending a silver film canister toward him across the deliberately empty half of a luggage trolley. She holds the threshold open for the same target and extends a silver film canister toward him; the adult target pauses and reaches toward the invitation, one open hand aimed at the canister. A brass signal key and cyanotype route map lie beside the canister. Frame both adults, threshold, canister, trolley gap, and reaching hands in a vertical two-shot from doorway height on a 28 mm lens. Warm tungsten booth light and cold skylight flashes meet on the wet floor. She wears an oxblood satin blouse under charcoal wool-gabardine tailoring. Both adults remain fully dressed.

Targeted repair only: edit Image 1 while preserving its two adults, faces, fully dressed wardrobe, station, threshold, trolley, canister transfer, the man's open reaching hand, vertical framing, wet floor, and warm-cold lighting. Rotate only the woman's shoulders, chest, and torso into an unmistakable three-quarter orientation toward the man, so her alert irises, head, and torso visibly converge on that same man. Image 2 supplies only her adult facial appearance and dark wavy hairstyle.
